newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia stocks (inventories) rise in Q4.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia stocks (inventories) rise in Q4.

text.p: The value of stocks held by Australian private businesses rose an estimated 1.2 percent, seasonally-adjusted, to A$61.731 billion in the December quarter from the September quarter, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
The September quarter value of stocks rose a revised 1.4 percent to A$60.971 billion (previously A$62.04 billion).
It also said sales by manufacturers fell an estimated 0.8 percent in the December quarter from the September quarter.
Both figures are at constant 1989/90 prices.

The bureau said the third estimate for manufacturers' expected (current price) sales for 1996/97 ending June 30 was A$185.16 billion compared to a second estimate of A$189.51 billion.
